method: Priority-50 desk research (CC-05). Web search of published guides (mia.vn, Grab Food blog, Tuổi Trẻ, VnExpress, greensm, Saigoneer). Searches for chả cá Lã Vọng, xôi xéo, bún sứa, bún đỏ and bánh tằm bì returned no named HCMC venue with an address. Skipped: the 34-year bún thang shop at 50 Hồ Biểu Chánh (source gives no shop name), Hớn Hưng (hủ tiếu sa tế, not Mỹ Tho style), Hủ tiếu Cả Cần (no street number), Dương Bá Trạc bún cá street (no specific shop), venues located in Sóc Trăng/Gia Lai/Đắk Lắk.
